description: Draft a trap after a failure was fixed. Private by default with a Pro or Team key. Public filings are checked automatically against official sources and published only when an official source confirms them. A reviewer can still act on any filing. Citing the provider's official documentation or changelog in sources helps. No API key needed. Set visibility to public to submit to the public registry.

affected.description: Which versions, plans or dates are affected.

apply.description: A short code or command example of the fix.

fix.description: What to change, in plain words.

provider.description: The service, by slug or common name, e.g. "stripe".

sources.description: Official documentation or changelog URLs that confirm it.

surface_name.description: The specific endpoint, package, command or screen, e.g. "webhooks.constructEvent".

surface_type.description: Which kind of surface broke: api, sdk, ui, billing, infra, or tool (CLIs and AI coding tools).

symptoms.description: Exact error messages or observed behavior, one per item. Leave out secrets and personal data.

title.description: One line naming what goes wrong, as a developer would search for it.

visibility.description: public submits to the shared registry; private keeps it in your team's space (Pro or Team key).

name: file_trap
title: File a new trap
